description: Permission set for artifact widget windows (the deck — PRD Part C / W2). Opaque, frameless, always-on-top panels that render ONE pinned artifact and magnetically dock to the chat. The `widget-*` glob means any other label gets NO IPC at all (fails closed — PRD §23 derisk). These windows deliberately get a NARROWER set than the main window: they may move/resize/drag/close themselves and read the anchor window's geometry for snapping, connect to the same WS server (load-connection), and close themselves — nothing else.
